newsitem.title: UK: LME copper hovers above $2,000 in late activity.
newsitem.headline: LME copper hovers above $2,000 in late activity.

text.p: Copper held just above the key $2,000 level in late inter-office tradingafter earlier breaching the psychological barrier.
Traders said the high trade in three months metal had been $2,005, the strongest level since copper hit $2,070 per tonne on September 4.
At 1805 GMT, prices were indicated at $2,000/05, compared to an afternoon kerb close of $1,993.
Prices were being boosted by short-covering and expectations of another large decline in LME stocks on Friday. Stocks fell by 13,075 tonnes on Tuesday.
But chartists warned that the eight-day stochastics indicator was becoming oversold and momentum indicators were diverging from prices, suggesting that exhaustion was setting in.
Prices could spike up to $2,020/30 before a correction set in, some analysts said.
Aluminium firmed slightly to $1,430/33 from a afternoon kerb close of $1,424, but the others were little changed.
